title: JEFF Skills Registry
description: Registry of Claude Code skills managed by JEFF. Skills are auto-injected into task workspaces based on persona, task type, and tag matching.

skills.description: Map of skill name to skill configuration.

location.description: Absolute path to the skill directory containing SKILL.md.

tags.description: Free-form tags matched against gig task labels. Any intersection triggers injection.

personas.description: Persona names. If the pickup persona matches any, the skill is injected.

gig_type.description: Gig task types. If the task type matches any, the skill is injected.
